messages:
mira: Heads-up — saw a weird fragmentation event in dedicated-east1 after the tenant surge at 02:10 UTC. Lots of 0.25/0.5 GPU leftovers spread across racks, routing keeps bouncing small requests and increasing latency for small-chat clients. dashboard: https://redwood.internal/prod/allocs?pool=dedicated-east1

sam: ugh. is this the same fractional-slice allocator bug we saw last month or something different?

mira: looks similar but not identical. allocation log shows many tiny residual slots because packer didn't coalesce after preemptible reclaim. paste of simplified logs:
```
2026-03-18T02:09:58Z packer: reclaim tenant=alpha preemptible=evicted -> freed 2.0 gpus
2026-03-18T02:10:02Z packer: place tenant=beta request=0.5 -> placed on slot=0.5@node-17
2026-03-18T02:10:07Z packer: place tenant=gamma request=0.25 -> placed slot=0.25@node-23
2026-03-18T02:10:12Z packer: packer-coalesce skipped due to lock contention (pack-coalesce-loop)
```

lee: so coalesce skipped under lock. sounds like contention from the egress-controller reconcile job. saw a spike in reconcile loops at the same time.

pj: any metrics? egress or NIC saturation can make placements slow and cause the tiny spreads.

mira: attach from metrics - allocation latency spiked 4x for 30s, net qdepth up ~60% on rack-3. Also observed our routing policy bouncing small requests to fallback pools which increased p99.

ops-bot: Incident alert: ROUTING-REGION-THROTTLE triggered; affected service: text-generation-small; severity: P2.

tess: @sam @mira can we short-circuit fallback for requests <=0.5 GPU to prefer co-located nodes during the next 10m window? that'll reduce cross-rack egress spikes.

sam: we can change routing policy param `min_pref_size` quickly, but risk increasing local contention for bigger allocs. propose temporary rule: prefer_local for <=0.5 and set preemptible-facing weight +0.2.

mira: agree for short window. also want a graceful coalesce retry job to run immediately after reclaim notices. probably a fix to packer to backoff locks and try again.

lee: I can push a quick patch to scheduler to run coalesce asynchronously on reclaim events. small TS change: add async_coalesce=true for reclaim path.

pj: let's do controlled rollout to staging first (reproduce with synthetic surge) then prod. I can simulate surge on staging now if you want.

sre-oncall: timeline? if we keep routing change + coalesce patch we should see p99 drop within 2 deploys. I'll keep watch and be ready to revert routing tweak.

mira: plan of action: 1) sam will flip routing flag for <=0.5 to prefer_local for 15m (hotpatch). 2) lee will open a PR with async_coalesce and stage deploy. 3) pj runs synthetic surge in staging and validates packing. 4) sre-oncall watches prod metrics and rollback if p99 doesn't improve in 10m. I'll file a ticket and add runbook notes. @ops-bot please create incident record with those steps. :white_check_mark:

sam: doing routing flip now. will post revert time.

lee: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/packer/pull/482 - async_coalesce, unit + integration tests included. staging deploy queued.

pj: staging surge running -> packing looks much better; residual 0.25 slots reduced by ~78%.

sre-oncall: prod p99 dropping, egress Q depth normalizing. leaving monitoring for 30m.

mira: thanks all. follow-ups: ticket INFRA-1423, postmortem if any regression. closing thread when monitoring window ends.
